content.text:
My review is complete. The document contains no liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum-fee charge payable by us:

- **Fees (Art. V, p0050–p0070, p0086):** all amounts are usage-based license fees, taxes and a $2,500/month support fee — pure consideration, with no late-payment penalty or interest charge.
- **Term/termination (p0049, p0138):** on Licensor termination for breach, Licensor retains only "the right to receive payments for all trades performed" — accrued fees, not accelerated or stipulated damages.
- **Art. XXIII (p0142):** expressly bars termination damages in both directions.
- **Supplemental Payments (p0078)** is a revenue share, and **p0064** audit-cost shifting is actual-cost reimbursement, not a stipulated sum.

input.quote: ARTICLE XXIII NON EXCLUSIVE REMEDY Termination of this Agreement by either party will be a nonexclusive remedy for breach and will be without prejudice to any other right or remedy of such party. NO DAMAGES FOR TERMINATION. NEITHER PARTY WILL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER FOR DAMAGES OF ANY KIND, INCLUDING WITHOUT LIMITATION INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES, DAMAGES FOR THE LOSS OF GOODWILL, PROSPECTIVE PROFITS OR ANTICIPATED INCOME, OR DAMAGES RESULTING FROM ANY EXPENDITURES, INVESTMENTS, LEASES OR COMMITMENTS MADE BY EITHER PARTY ON ACCOUNT OF THE TERMINATION OR EXPIRATION OF THIS AGREEMENT IN ACCORDANCE WITH ITS TERMS.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no liquidated damages or penalties on us, meeting the preferred position. I checked every payment and termination provision: the fee architecture (Art. V, p0050-p0058; volume-band fees and timing, p0066-p0070; $2,500/month support fee, p0086) consists solely of usage-based consideration with no late-payment penalty, minimum-volume shortfall charge, or early-termination fee. On termination for Licensee breach, Art. IV (p0049) preserves for Licensor only "the right to receive payments for all trades performed using the Licensed Technology" — accrued fees actually earned, not an accelerated or stipulated sum, so there is no acceleration of remaining contract value. Art. XXI (p0138) requires only return/certification of materials, with no exit payment. Art. XXIII (p0142) affirmatively bars termination damages in both directions, which favours us. Two minor points noted but not flagged: the audit cost-shifting on a >5% discrepancy (p0064) is reimbursement of actual audit cost rather than a stipulated penalty, and the 33% "Supplemental Payments" revenue share (p0078) is ongoing consideration, not a damages measure. The rebate shares (p0076) run from Licensor to us and are compliant by direction. No redline required.
